# VeltriX

VeltriX designs and manufactures precision plastic injection molds and engineering mold solutions for Iran and export markets.

## Services
- Plastic injection molds
- Hot Runner and Valve Gate
- Medical and packaging molds
- Automotive and appliance molds
- Thermoforming and die casting
- Initial project review from drawings or 3D files

## Languages
Persian, English, Turkish, Arabic, and Azerbaijani.
